Card Q&A.q: Can this card's effect return the target cards to the top of the deck even when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [Main] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by returning 3 cards with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait from your trash to the top of the deck, delete up to 6 play cost's total worth of your opponent's Digimon.
